title: Meet the Team at Studio One
meta_title: Meet the Team at Studio One
meta_description: Meet the talented stylists at Studio One salon in Fresno, CA. Learn about their specialties in color, extensions, keratin treatments, and more.
author: Studio One
body_text:
More Than Stylists Behind the Chair

At Studio One, we believe a salon is only as special as the people who make it thrive. Our team is more than just a group of stylists—we’re educators, creatives, and confidence-builders who care deeply about every guest who sits in our chairs. Each member of our team brings a unique skill set, passion, and personality to the salon, making Studio One a place where beauty, artistry, and connection come together. When you meet our team, you’ll discover more than talent—you’ll discover a supportive, uplifting salon family dedicated to helping you look and feel your absolute best.

Meet Carina – Extensions & Gray Coverage Specialist

Carina is your go-to for flawless gray coverage, subtle highlights, and seamless extensions. She has a talent for creating looks that feel natural and polished, making sure her guests always leave with confidence that shines from the inside out. Whether you’re refreshing your color or looking for added fullness with extensions, Carina’s approach is thoughtful, precise, and designed to enhance your natural beauty.

Meet Hope – Color, Perms & Hair Loss Solutions

Hope combines creativity with compassion to meet her guests’ unique needs. She specializes in color services, perms, and personalized hair loss solutions, offering both artistry and empathy. Hope understands that hair is deeply personal, and she takes the time to ensure her guests feel supported through every stage of life. Her goal is always to leave guests feeling radiant, cared for, and confident.

Meet Makayla – Gray Coverage, Keratin & Extensions

Makayla has a gift for making hair look and feel naturally beautiful. Her specialties include gray coverage, soft highlights, Brazilian keratin treatments, and extensions. Guests love her ability to create consistent results that bring shine, smoothness, and manageability back to their hair. Whether it’s taming frizz, brightening color, or adding natural fullness, Makayla always delivers transformations that are both effortless and long-lasting.

Meet Amber – Balayage & Precision Haircuts

Amber isn’t new to hair—just new to Fresno. With years of experience and the privilege of training alongside one of Vidal Sassoon’s top artists, she brings a refined and artistic approach to her craft. Amber specializes in balayage, dimensional color, and precision haircuts, always focusing on shape, balance, and movement. Her Sassoon background has given her a foundation in artistry and intention, allowing her to deliver results that are timeless, modern, and tailored to each guest.

Meet Cat – Extensions & Custom Color

Cat is the owner of Studio One and the visionary behind everything we do. With nearly 30 years behind the chair, she specializes in extensions and custom color that feel polished and natural. Known for her expertise in creating results that save women time while boosting confidence, Cat has built Studio One into a salon that celebrates artistry, innovation, and community. Her leadership and experience ensure that every guest who walks through our doors feels welcomed, cared for, and completely transformed.

Book Your Appointment Today

The best part? You don’t have to choose just one stylist—you can explore each of their specialties and find the perfect fit for your hair journey. Ready to meet our team in person? Book your appointment now and see everyone’s availability online.
